startedWith: Isolated Spring + MediaMTX + FFmpeg + production React + headless Edge

results.name: New account has no fabricated history
Opening a waiting broadcast does not create history
A history save failure does not interrupt video playback
Advancing real HLS video saves server broadcast metadata
Transient failure retries after cooldown instead of every media event
Successful watch visit does not send repeated writes
The saved record can be deleted while the player stays mounted
Continuing playback does not recreate a deleted record
Revisiting and playing the broadcast creates a new watched visit
Broadcast ending preserves history and marks it unavailable
Ended history is not linked to another broadcast on the same path
PostgreSQL history and Redis login survive API restart
No browser runtime or interception errors during actual playback
Actual watch-history check uses HLS without WHEP fallback
History UI pagination, filters, deletion and mobile checks pass

limits: Single PC, loopback and headless Edge only
No iPhone/Android physical-device, Caddy HTTPS/WSS or load verification
Metadata-only fixtures are used separately for history pagination UI
